# Amit Sah — iOS Developer and Backend Engineer

> Professional portfolio of Amit Sah, a Senior iOS Developer and Backend Engineer based in New Delhi, India, with 5+ years of experience and 30+ production apps.

The résumé is the source for professional claims. Featured work includes Zaytun AI, Goodspace, Zoconut, LolliCash, University Intoto, Dream Home Automation, Gurudai, and CountryPickerAKS. Project links describe Amit's contributions; they do not imply ownership of the companies or products.
